description: This file contains mock implementations and wrapper functions for system calls, designed for testing purposes. It uses Google Mock and provides wrapper functions for various system functions such as system(), popen(), pclose(), syslog(), setmntent(), getmntent(), readlink(), and time(). The code manages an instance of WrapsImpl to delegate actual system calls and includes functions for setting and getting this implementation. It also defines wrapped functions using extern "C" for integration with C code.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A singleton class that provides wrapped system call functions and delegates their implementation to an injected WrapsImpl instance.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An interface class defining the actual system call implementations that can be customized or mocked for testing.
